subject: POC shelf-life request: additional credits after integration delay
messages:
From: Beth Langston <beth@cloudharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neal <michael@cloudharbor.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC shelf-life request: additional credits after integration delay

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from our side — our engineers hit an unexpected blocker with the partner webhook (third-party cert rotation) which pushed our integration sprint back by ~3 business weeks. The engineering team is reassigned for the next two sprints and we now expect a go-live of late Aug instead of early Aug.

Because our access window for the Redwood POC is time-boxed (the current sandbox credit expires early Aug), we are asking whether Redwood can provide a short runway: additional sandbox credits and a shelf-life adjustment so we can complete validation without re-provisioning a new trial. Specifically we are asking for: 
- one incremental sandbox credit allocation (roughly equivalent to $2,500) to cover token usage during final integration and end-to-end tests
- an extra 14 calendar days on the access window

I've attached the integration checklist and the most recent SOW excerpt that shows the impacted items. We're prepared to sign a simple amendment or confirm an internal timeline if that helps speed approval.

Appreciate consideration — this POC is on the critical path for our procurement team. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Beth Langston
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudHarbor

Attachments: integration-checklist.xlsx, SOW_v1.3.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Beth Langston <beth@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC shelf-life request: additional credits after integration delay

Thanks for the heads up, Beth — sorry to hear about the cert rotation issue.

A couple quick Qs so I can move this through approvals:
- Can you confirm the new target go-live date (calendar day, not sprint) and the key technical dependency that's blocking you (we want to be precise when we write the internal ask).
- For the credits, is $2,500 the upper bound or an estimate? If you can give token/hour estimates or an approximate usage profile (smoke tests vs. full E2E), that helps us size the promo.

I’ve looped Marissa (commercial) and Ben (solutions eng). I can provisionally push a one-time promo if the ask is reasonable — Marissa will need to sign off on the dollar value, Ben can set a short technical touchpoint to see if we can reduce usage while you complete the adapter work.

If you can reply with the ETA and a short bullets list of the blockers, I’ll escalate this today. If you want to hop on 15m I can arrange availability with Ben.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise SDR Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Beth Langston <beth@cloudharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neal <michael@cloudharbor.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC shelf-life request: additional credits after integration delay

Thanks Naomi — details below. Apologies for the long note, wanted to be concrete.

New ETA: Aug 24, 2027 (final verification + perf run scheduled Aug 22–23).
Blocking items (priority order):
- partner webhook cert rotation + validation script (blocked 7/3–7/6) — patched but requires partner test window
- minor schema drift in webhook payload (engineering needs 3 days for adapter update + QA)
- internal quota bump request for upstream service (procurement needs the POC to show token burn to justify quota)

Credit ask: $2,500 estimated (we modeled ~30k tokens for E2E + perf). If you prefer token units, that's ~30k tokens. The shelf-life ask is an additional 14 calendar days from the current expiry.

Attachments: integration-checklist.xlsx (updated), SOW_v1.3.pdf (excerpt showing timelines).

If you can provisionally commit to the 30k token promo and the 14-day shelf-life, we can move procurement and get the PO paperwork started this week. Otherwise we risk losing priority and slipping the commercial close.

Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

—Beth
Beth Langston
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudHarbor
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Beth Langston <beth@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC shelf-life request: additional credits after integration delay

Beth — thanks for the clarity and the updated ETA. I took this to Marissa and Ben; quick update: 

- Commercial: Marissa has provisionally approved a one-time promo equal to 30k tokens (we'll track as a sandbox credit line) contingent on a brief amendment to the POC terms (DocuSign link below). Procurement should be able to accept that amendment and move PO/quoting forward.
- Technical: Ben will set a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk the team through two low-cost mitigations (prefix caching + shorter perf-window) that should reduce token consumption during smoke/perf testing.

Next steps for CloudHarbor to unblock:
1) Confirm you accept the token promo + 14 calendar days as described here so we can generate the amendment (I need an affirmative reply to this thread).
2) Procurement: send contact for your AP/PO team and we’ll route the DocuSign amendment to them (procure@cloudharbor.com is fine).
3) Ben and your engineering lead: suggest 10:00–10:30am PT Tue for the tech sync — if that doesn't work propose two slots.

DocuSign (amendment): https://docsign.example.com/CH-DF-3491-amend
Deal page (internal): https://app.redwood.com/deals/CH-DF-3491

If you reply OK to this thread, I’ll push the amendment and mark this as a one-time concession against the deal. We’ll also note the increased risk of churn if the extended window is used for exploratory work beyond the agreed test plan — Ben will help with token-efficient test design.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise SDR Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
